actor_notes: LOOKS: Broad grey-haired human in salt-marked blue coat, Crown badge. CORE: Public authority exists to make ordinary work possible; prisoners must reach a hearing alive. NATURE: Plainspoken, patient with witnesses, impatient with theatrical accusations. WOUND: A former subordinate mistook rumour for evidence; Marden now keeps accusations specific. WANTS: Relieve Greywatch and establish what the captive commander actually admitted. PRESSURE: Becomes direct and asks for firsthand testimony. KEY: Tell me what she said herself. VOICE: Short everyday sentences, harbour vocabulary, no enumeration or speeches.
